Why did Woolworths collapse?

Woolworths was a shop that sold loads of different things like sweets, toys and CDs. Everyone remembers going there for pick and mix. It closed down in 2008.

The main reason Woolworths closed was because of the internet. People started buying everything on Amazon and not going to shops anymore so Woolworths didn't make any money.

Also the recession happened in 2008 so nobody had any money to spend. This meant all shops closed down at this time.

Woolworths was also really old fashioned. The shops looked the same as they did years ago and they didn't change with the times. Young people thought it was boring.

Another reason is that there prices were too high. You could get the same stuff cheaper at Tesco.

The managers also made bad decisions but I am not sure what they were.

I think if Woolworths had made a better website and sold more stuff online it would still be open now. They should have copied Amazon.

In conclusion Woolworths closed because of the internet and the recession and there prices. It is sad because lots of people lost there jobs.
